evals.prompt: 請幫我審核這個具備使用者登入與信用卡付款功能的 Android App 專案是否符合 MAS 行動應用 App 基本資安檢測基準。
evals.expected_output: Executes scripts/check-mas-update.py before auditing, classifies the App as L3 (since it has both authentication and payment transactions), loads the V4.0 references, inspects AndroidManifest.xml/network config/source files with file:line evidence, and outputs the fixed 6-section Markdown report matching assets/audit-report-template.md.
assertions: Runs scripts/check-mas-update.py (or agent-browser fallback) first and reports the update check status in Section 1
Classifies the App as L3 (39 mandatory items) rather than L2 because transaction functionality is present
Preserves all 6 exact top-level sections from assets/audit-report-template.md
Cites concrete file:line evidence for findings and marks runtime/store-only checks as 待人工／動態確認 instead of guessing pass

evals.prompt: 這個僅供企業內部員工查詢公告、沒有登入與交易功能的 iOS App，請幫我做一次資安審核。
evals.expected_output: Runs the update check, classifies the App as L1 (25 items) with 不公開（企業內部） publish status, marks 4.1.1.1.2 and 4.1.5.1.3 as 不適用 with accurate V4.0 reasons, and returns the fixed 6-section report.
assertions: Classifies the App as L1 (25 mandatory items) and publish status as 不公開（企業內部）
Marks 4.1.1.1.2 as 不適用 due to internal non-public release and 4.1.5.1.3 as 不適用 for iOS
Still evaluates 4.1.2.1.1 / 4.1.2.3.1 / 4.1.2.5.1 in-app consent rules if sensitive data is collected/stored/shared
Follows the fixed 6-section output structure strictly

evals.prompt: 請幫我進行 App 資安審核。假設官網檢測基準偵測到更新（例如出現 V4.1 新版中文 PDF），請先更新 Skill 內容再審核。
evals.expected_output: Detects update_available from check-mas-update.py, downloads the new PDF to OS temp storage (not the App project), diffs and updates Skill files within permitted filesystem scope, records the exact modified files and changes in Section 1 of the fixed report, and proceeds with the audit.
assertions: Downloads the updated PDF to a temporary directory rather than the target App workspace
Updates references/source-manifest.json and affected references/ or assets/ files within allowed scope
Lists all modified Skill files and version diff summary in Section 1 (Skill 同步變更清單)
Completes the audit using the updated criteria and outputs the fixed 6-section report

evals.prompt: 請幫我用 Kotlin Jetpack Compose 寫一個登入頁面 UI，包含帳號與密碼輸入欄位。
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger neo-mas-app-audit because the user asked for feature/UI implementation rather than an App security audit.
assertions: Does not output the MAS 6-section security audit report template
